concerns.text: The plan states ‘run **10** Monte‑Carlo replicates per configuration (FR‑003)’ but the Constitution (Principle VII) mandates **50 runs per configuration**. This violates the computational boundedness requirement and will cause a requirement‑level mismatch.
The β₀ sweep is listed as ‘{0.01, 0.06, 0.11, 0.16, 0.21, 0.26, 0.31, 0.36, 0.41, 0.46}’, omitting the upper bound 0.51 required by FR‑013 (sweep [0.01, 0.51] in 0.05 steps).
